PHYSICAL_SAFETY.reason: Physical/runtime safety envelopes, security and determinism machinery (path sandboxing, crash recovery, matrix math, canonical hashing, capability tiers). Not aesthetic judgement.

EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY.reason: Gates that detect fabricated or unreferenced evidence (provenance integrity), not taste.

SELECTION_MECHANISM.reason: Zero-implicit-rule operator selection: an operator is chosen only when a declared principle AND an active relationship both match (set cardinality checks, no aesthetic magnitude).

MEASUREMENT_MECHANISM.reason: Operational definition of how a metric is measured from pixels/frames (estimator). Stays in the compiler; the estimator identity and bias are declared in the contract's metric definitions.

CAPABILITY_TIER.reason: Host capability tiers and data-quality (G1) policy.

FIDELITY_METRIC.reason: Frozen 5-D fidelity evaluators that compare render to target. Verification mechanism owned by the compiler.

DOCS_NON_AESTHETIC.reason: Technical acceptance criteria in playbooks (image resolution, byte sizes, bit depth).
